messages:
Mia Chen: Heads up — vendor just flagged that part of the EU rack shipment is moving from air to sea. Effectively +21d to ETA, affects Dedicated ramp. Need decision on partial acceptance or reschedule. cc @Ash @Jordan :ship:

Ash Patel: Do we know how much volume? any manifest?

Lina (VendorOps): Vendor sent manifest, looks like 18 racks (of 90) moved to sea. Shipping IDs: SLOW-9087, SLOW-9088. ETA now 2026-04-22 for sea leg. Air pieces still ETA 2026-04-01. Snippet:
```
sku,rack_id,mode,eta
GPU-X,rx-1901,air,2026-04-01
GPU-X,rx-1902,sea,2026-04-22
... (18 rows sea)
```

Jordan Lee: Options: 1) accept air-only partial fulfill for customer-facing Dedicated launches, 2) pull 20% from global buffer pool, 3) temporarily open marketplace burst for impacted customers. Which do we want? 

Zane Rivera: Customers with contracts? A few enterprise customers need full racks by 04-10. If we do partial, need comms + prorated credits. 

Mia Chen: @Lina can we get vendor to split packing so air pieces prioritized to enterprise customers? Also @Ash can you check buffer pool availability? 

Lina (VendorOps): Asked vendor — they can reprioritize 6 racks to air if we cover extra freight cost (~$18k). They want answer by EOD. 

Ash Patel: Buffer pool shows 14 racks available in staging EU. We can reallocate 10 with minimal impact to other pilots. 

Jordan Lee: If we reassign 10 from buffer -> cover 04-10 commitments. Remaining gap 8 racks — suggest offer credits + marketplace burst to make up. I'll draft comms. Link to tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prov/issues/342 

shipment-bot: ETA updated for SLOW-9087, SLOW-9088 -> 2026-04-22 ; manifest uploaded to GCS: gs://prod-manifests/shipments/1759999999-manifest.csv 

Mia Chen: Plan: (1) reassign 10 racks from buffer (Ash) (2) vendor to air-prioritize 6 if we approve freight (Lina to negotiate) (3) Jordan will draft customer comms + credit calc (4) @Zane own SLA impact calc. Agree? :thumbsup: 

Zane Rivera: Agreed. I'll put SLA impact numbers in tracker tonight. :eyes: 

Lina (VendorOps): Vendor wants confirmation by 17:00 UTC. I'll push for reduced freight cost. :pray:

Ash Patel: I'll kick the move and update inventory, target done by 02:00 UTC tomorrow. 

Jordan Lee: I'll post comms draft in the tracker and ping @support for playbook. 

Mia Chen: Thanks team — let's sync if vendor pushes different dates. Closing loop here unless new info. :white_check_mark:
